detail.longDescription: I am trying to install Playwright to my Linux Mint env. I use version 'Gigi', which is Debian-based, and Python version is 3.13.5. I am following examples from the docs to install Playwright. It seems to be successful: Successfully installed playwright-1.63.0 However when I try the next step in the instructions I get the following error: $ playwright install Failed to install browsers Error: ERROR: Playwright does not support chromium on ubuntu20.04-x64 I have tried this also on virtualenv with same results. Also same result if I try to install Firefox or Webkit.
